item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: KoiArt 1.24.1
item.description:
Mac Dynamic Weather Effects

KoiArt is a desktop dynamic effects and wallpaper beautification software for macOS that incorporates six effects – falling snow, falling leaves, shooting stars, raindrops, cherry blossoms, and fireflies – into your everyday desktop. Snowflakes accumulate on the top of windows and on the Dock, and the snow slides off when you drag the windows. Fallen leaves can be swept away by the cursor, and fireflies gather around a stationary cursor, giving the desktop an interactive seasonal atmosphere. The Christmas theme supports planting up to three Christmas trees, hanging baubles, lights, and candy canes, as well as making snowmen to place in windows and sending decorations or messages to friends' desktops via the Elf Train. The software offers nine hand-drawn wallpapers and a Christmas screensaver. Wallpapers can be applied to all monitors with one click, and the images can also be switched according to the time of day. The app resides in the menu bar. The special effects support click-through and do not affect the operation of the window below. It uses the graphics chip for rendering, reduces the intensity of special effects when running on battery power or in low-power mode, and pauses when a full-screen app covers the screen or the screen goes to sleep. Supports macOS 14 and later versions, is compatible with Apple silicon and Intel-based Macs, and has been signed and notarized by Apple. It only uses window position information and does not read window content.

item.title: AudioRefine 1.7
item.description:
Background noise cleanup for macOS recordings

AudioRefine is a local voice noise reduction and audio-visual processing software for macOS that removes background noise from audio and video recordings, making voices clearer and more natural. The software runs on Macs with Apple chips, and the AI model is used with the application. The entire recording process is handled locally, with no file uploads, and no account or continuous internet connection is required. It offers three cleanup modes – Studio, Enhance, and Fast – suitable for heavy noise, light noise, and quick processing, respectively. Before exporting, you can compare the original audio with the processed result and adjust the level of noise reduction. Voice Polish balances tone, reduces harsh sibilance, evens out volume, and sets loudness for podcasts, videos, or broadcasts. AudioRefine supports audio files as well as MP4 and MOV videos, and can export WAV, M4A, or processed videos that retain the original video. Supported videos retain the original video directly without re-encoding. Users can also process files in batches, view progress, cancel or retry tasks, and the original files always remain unchanged. The software is suitable for podcasts, interviews, voiceovers, courses, and video recordings, and also supports offline work and commercial use.

item.title: Rearview 1.1.0
item.description:
Portfolio backtesting software for macOS

Rearview is a native portfolio backtesting software for Macs with Apple chips. It supports stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, futures, and forex, and can test trading rules using daily or even one-minute market data. The software centralizes strategy scripts, yield curves, trade-by-trade transactions, market scans, account reviews, and historical performance records in a single window. It supports cross-asset ranking, position limits, rebalancing, multi-strategy capital allocation, and long-short trading. The backtesting process restricts the strategy to only read information that was known at the time, uses precise fund accounting and deterministic calculations, and cross-checks the results through an independent engine. The parameter study will cumulatively record the number of attempts and, in combination with the modified Sharpe ratio, the probability of overfitting in backtesting, randomized control, and out-of-sample testing, help identify fortuitous performance. The script, settings, engine version, and corresponding data version are retained for each run to facilitate replication and comparison after data updates. Users can also import brokerage transaction records, compare the differences between actual trades and backtests, and generate an order list for the next trading session. However, the software will not place orders on their behalf.

item.title: NetLookup 1.0.2
item.description:
Mac Network Comprehensive Analysis Toolkit

NetLookup is a comprehensive network analysis and diagnostic tool for macOS that combines connection checks, device discovery, wireless network analysis, and server management in a single interface. It identifies connection issues through a five-step test covering the network, router, internet, DNS, and HTTPS, and displays the public and local IP addresses, gateway, DNS servers, and VPN status. The LAN scanner can identify device names, models, manufacturers, Bonjour services, and open ports. It supports scanning across multiple address ranges, saving presets, and exporting tables. The software can also view DHCP leases, estimate address pools, detect rogue DHCP servers, and connect to compatible routers in read-only mode to obtain detailed information. Network topology diagrams, real-time wireless signal curves, and Wi-Fi radar help you understand device distribution and the surrounding wireless environment, and work with Ping, traceroute, MTR, DNS queries, and certificate checks to troubleshoot issues. Features for administrators include SSH, SFTP, FTP, scheduled scans, and PDF reports.

item.title: Tasklo 1.1.1
item.description:
macOS To-Do List Management

Tasklo: Reminders is a reminder and schedule planning tool for Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. It centralizes the lists from iCloud, Exchange, Outlook, and CalDAV accounts in Apple Reminders, making it easy to view today's, scheduled, overdue, and all tasks in a single interface. The software supports quick entry of items using natural language. On devices that support Apple Intelligence, it natively recognizes titles, dates, times, and the corresponding lists. Other devices use simple pattern matching. The Daily Schedule feature can schedule reminders without specified times into the gaps between calendar events and supports one-tap scheduling; With the Week View, drag-and-drop across dates, custom recurrence, and subtasks, it's easy to organize daily tasks and long-term to-dos. Users can also search task titles, notes, and checklists, access tasks via widgets, Siri, and Shortcuts, and share reminders and lists.

item.title: Status Trio 1.10.5
item.description:
iPhoneduo Style Menu Bar Status Tool

Status Trio is a native macOS system status tool that combines Wi-Fi, battery, and volume into a single, compact icon that can be placed in the menu bar, Dock, or both, reducing the space taken up by multiple status icons. The icon can display information about the wireless signal, battery level, charging status, volume, and mute status. The central area can also be switched to show the currently playing Bluetooth device, the current input method, the battery percentage, or the power level. Click to expand the status panel to view nearby wireless networks and connection details, manage paired Bluetooth devices, switch audio input and output, and adjust speaker and microphone volume. The battery details provide information such as adapter power, voltage, current, and number of cycles, and can also display estimated power flow and CPU power consumption impact as needed. The software supports adjusting icon sizes, symbol proportions, ring thicknesses, status colors, and the display order of panel sections. It also provides global hotkeys, login startup, and twelve interface languages, including Simplified and Traditional Chinese. The system status is read locally, and anonymous usage statistics can be enabled by the user. Wireless network switching still needs to be done through system settings, and the software does not read or save Wi-Fi passwords.

item.title: LaunchingPad 4.5
item.description:
Launchpad Alternative Software Launcher

LaunchingPad is an application manager and launcher for macOS 26 Tahoe and later versions. It brings back the traditional Launchpad page and folder experience with a customizable grid interface and is compatible with both Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Users can open the app grid via keyboard shortcuts, F4, trackpad gestures, screen hot corners, the menu bar, or the Dock. They can also choose full-screen mode or a resizable floating window. The app supports fuzzy search, lists of recently used and most frequently used apps, nested folders, aliases, and smart folders with automatically updated content. It also allows batch selection of apps, undoing and redoing layout actions, and using the keyboard for navigation and organization. The grid size, app icons, folder symbols, page layout, and opening animation can all be customized. Importing older Launchpad layouts is also supported. Management features include viewing app versions, signatures, architectures, and permissions, checking for app updates from the Mac App Store, Homebrew, and Sparkle, and uninstalling apps after displaying residual preferences, caches, and support files.

item.title: Mute 2.0.2
item.description:
Mac Microphone Automatic Do Not Disturb Software

Mute is an automatic Do Not Disturb tool that runs in the macOS menu bar. It automatically activates the system's Do Not Disturb Focus mode when it detects that the microphone or camera is being used by an application, helping to reduce notification interruptions during meetings, calls, and video recordings. It does not require individual configuration for applications such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, FaceTime, etc., and also works with other programs that access the microphone or camera. Users can enable or disable automatic muting in the menu bar and choose to monitor both the microphone and camera, monitor only the microphone, or monitor only the camera. Mute detects microphone status through CoreAudio and camera usage through AVCaptureDevice. When switching Focus modes, it invokes the macOS shortcut installed during the initial setup, avoiding reliance on private APIs or special permissions. The software supports macOS 14 Sonoma and later versions and is available via the Mac App Store, Homebrew, or a notarized DMG installer. The project is licensed under the MIT License.

item.title: EMU-Script 1.2
item.description:
EMU Music Script Editor

EMU-Script is a text-based electronic music creation software for macOS that integrates scripting, MIDI arranging, and score viewing into a single workflow. Users can write EMU music scripts in the built-in editor and use syntax highlighting and error checking to identify issues. The multi-track MIDI sequencer is suitable for organizing different instrument parts, and the score view can automatically scroll during playback and supports zooming and displaying staves in one to three octaves. The software supports compatible virtual instruments or external synthesizers driven by MIDI notes, control change, and program change messages. It also provides compositional tools such as song structure, sequence functions, chord progressions, strumming, arpeggios, and specialized notation for percussion instruments. The version update improves error messages, chart display, and bar unison playback, and adds controller definitions based on instrument settings. EMU-Script provides a user manual, a language reference manual, and script examples. It is suitable for creators who prefer to describe musical structures in text, are familiar with MIDI arranging, or wish to build electronic works using scripts. Connected synthesizers or virtual instruments must be MIDI-compatible, and plugins are not supported.

item.title: Folia Files 1.6
item.description:
Finder Alternative for Mac File Management

Folia Files is a native macOS file manager written in Swift. It is compatible with macOS 14 and later, works with both Apple silicon and Intel Macs, and offers a Simplified Chinese interface. It supports a dual-pane and freely draggable multi-pane layout, allowing folders, terminals, and function modules to be placed side by side. Commonly used operating environments can be saved through tabs, scenes, and workspaces. The software offers nine file views and supports independent configuration of folder sorting, grouping, and display modes. It also allows for customization of themes, window transparency, folder icons, and backgrounds. The search function not only covers file names but also allows you to search document text, text in screenshots, and image content. Combined with a locally running natural language assistant, it enables you to complete searches and file organization. Cloud storage, NAS, and remote servers can be accessed centrally. Combined with folder synchronization, scheduled backups, batch renaming, duplicate file detection, PDF processing, and automatic organization rules, it covers daily data management needs. The screen edge drawer, clipboard history, open and save dialog assistants, and disk space analysis further expand the range of available actions.

item.title: ElementNote 2.16.0
item.description:
Handwritten Notes and PDF Annotation Tools

Element Note is a handwriting note-taking, PDF annotation, and lightweight drawing app for macOS, iPadOS, and iOS, emphasizing a simple interface, a natural writing feel, and a high-quality rendering experience. It offers a variety of writing tools, including pencils, pens, ballpoint pens, art brushes, and markers. It also supports gradient ink, stroke smoothing, and Apple Pencil Pro's squeeze, haptic feedback, hover, and roll interactions, making classroom notes, study annotations, journal planning, and sketching feel more like using real paper and pen. The app allows you to insert text, shapes, stickers, and images. It supports practical features such as importing annotations from PDFs, batch exporting, lasso selection, moving content across pages, creating notes from photo albums, and more. With native OCR, you can search PDFs and handwritten content. Combined with tags, subfolders, folder colors, multi-select drag-and-drop, and page organization features, it is suitable for long-term management of a large number of notes. iCloud syncing and collaboration allow notes to be quickly updated across multiple devices and support collaborative editing by multiple users. The intelligent dark mode adjusts the reading environment according to the system appearance while maintaining consistency in the colors of the paper and handwriting.

item.title: Capture 3.8
item.description:
Note-taking and idea-gathering tool for macOS

Quick Notes – Capture is a quick note-taking and idea-gathering tool for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, and Apple Watch, with a core experience centered around low-friction input, instant organization, and cross-app flow. It is suitable for first capturing spontaneous ideas, to-do lists, web links, image attachments, voice content, and reminders, and then exporting them as needed to commonly used tools such as Obsidian, Things, Todoist, iA Writer, Craft, OmniFocus, Fantastical, Apple Calendar, Reminders, etc. The software supports iCloud syncing, desktop and lock screen widgets, share extensions, Siri and Shortcuts, automatic recognition of dates and URLs, document scanning, list sorting, merging and splitting of records, and other features. It can serve both as a daily outlet for clearing your mind and as a hub between different productivity systems. Its interface emphasizes simplicity and stability, avoiding distractions caused by complex workflows, allowing users to quickly save ideas when inspiration strikes and then process, archive, or execute them at the appropriate time.

item.title: Bear 熊掌记 3.0.6
item.description:
Markdown Writing and Note Taking Tools

BearMaster is an elegant and easy-to-use Markdown writing software designed to help users capture inspiration, write conveniently, and plan to-dos to keep life organized. It is suitable for people from all walks of life, such as writers, lawyers, chefs, CEOs, teachers, doctors, engineers, students and parents, and is extremely easy to use, without the need to register or create an account to get started. Bear Bearmaster supports a variety of text formats, including right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, and Farsi, and can easily create notes through Siri and shortcuts, emphasizing privacy and ensuring the privacy of users' notes. It supports a flexible Markdown language that makes text easy to migrate and preserves various Markdown formats. Users can efficiently organize their notes through tags and to-dos, and easily share notes to any third-party app. Bear Bearmaster also offers deep search capabilities, including searching for images and text in PDFs (requires a Bear Pro subscription).

item.title: Verso 1.0.74
item.description:
Native Lightweight Word Processor

Verso Writer is a native lightweight word processor for macOS that emphasizes fast startup, focused writing, and reliable document compatibility. It opens and saves DOCX, Markdown, RTF, ODT, TXT and other common formats for collaboration between Microsoft Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, GitHub and other workflows. The software provides compact toolbars, elegant page layout, focus mode, paperless mode, a variety of page appearance, table of contents, annotations, revisions, footnotes, header and footer, tables, images, find replacements and word count and other writing and typesetting capabilities. Markdown files can be visually edited and preserved in rich text, and code blocks support syntax highlighting; BibTeX and CSL JSON reference management can generate references in multiple formats. The app is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It does not rely on Electron, web view or cloud account. The interface supports multiple languages. It is suitable for Mac writers who need low burden, privacy-friendly, and full-featured.

item.title: AnySearch Pro 3.6.3
item.description:
File search tool for macOS

AnySearch Pro is a fast file search and disk content analysis tool for macOS that uses smart indexing and full-text search to find files among hundreds of thousands. A global hotkey opens a floating search panel from any app, and you can search by contains, prefix, suffix, exact match or wildcard. It supports combined filters (extension, type, size, modified date, folder scope, disk source) and searches the text of PDF, Markdown, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, highlighting matches in snippets. Results support quick preview, opening, revealing in Finder, and copying names or paths. Real-time file system monitoring keeps the index current, including iCloud Drive and external USB and Thunderbolt disks.

item.title: FileBo 1.3.2
item.description:
macOS File Quick Access Tool

FileBo is a quick access tool for recent files that resides in the macOS menu bar, and it pops up a simple window showing the files and folders you recently used, changed, saved, or downloaded, like a smart drawer that fills in automatically, solving everyday problems that files can't find immediately after saving or downloading. Finder excels at a lot of things, but remembering exactly where that file went five minutes ago is not always its strong point, FileBo puts recent files, folders, apps, and connected drives all at the touch of a button, even inside a full-screen app, so you can instantly get back to the document, picture, zip, or project you were working on. It's more focused and practical than Finder's built-in view of recent projects, designed to quickly retrieve what you're working on, and you can decide where you want to track, add unwanted files or folders to your ignore list, and eliminate things you never want to see.

item.title: Day One 2026.24
item.description:
Mac Elegant Journal Tool

Day One is a legendary digital diary artifact (supports iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch cross-platform seamless use) that has won Apple's annual app award, more than 15 million downloads worldwide and has 200,000 5-star praise, redefining the way of private life recording, allowing users to safely record their lives anytime, anywhere through unlimited text, unlimited photos/videos *, audio, Markdown rich text format and other multimedia formats, with end-to-end encryption , password/Touch ID/Face ID protection, automatic backup and PDF/plain text/JSON and other export methods to ensure that 100% privacy is not leaked, while providing daily reminder notifications, unique daily writing tips, custom templates, Today review, On This Day time revisit, tags/favorites/smart search, map location view and other powerful functions to help users easily form a habit of recording, organize diaries on different topics *, always review precious memories. The ultimate choice for diarists and heavy lifestyle chroniclers looking for the ultimate in privacy, security, beauty, and a cross-device experience.

item.title: TickTick 8.2.60
item.description:
Plan your daily to-dos efficiently

TickTick is to-do and task list software designed for macOS to help users get their daily work done efficiently. It supports more than 10 different platforms, including Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, etc., allowing users to manage tasks on all devices/networks. TickTick's core features include the ability to quickly add tasks via shortcuts (Command + Shift + A), instant alerts, task priority settings, flexible repetitive task settings, create checklists in tasks, sort tasks by order/date/name/priority, and synchronize tasks across all devices. Advanced features include grid and timeline views of calendars, task duration settings, custom smart lists, adding descriptions to checklists, subtask reminders, more lists and tasks (299 lists, each list can contain 999 tasks, each task can contain 199 subtasks), adding up to 5 reminders per task, sharing task lists to up to 19 members for better task collaboration, daily on Up to 99 attachments, etc.

item.title: Screen Mirror 2.50
item.description:
Mirror iPhone screen to Mac

Screen Mirror is a practical software for screen mirroring and controlling iOS devices. It mirrors the screen of an iPhone or iPad to a large Mac display via a USB connection, allowing users to operate and input using the Mac's high-quality audio system, keyboard, and mouse. It supports simultaneous connection of multiple iPhones/iPads, free adjustment of window size or full-screen display, direct typing on iOS devices using a Bluetooth keyboard, direct media casting to the Mac, easy screen sharing to Zoom or Teams meetings, and utilization of macOS. The screen recording feature simultaneously records the screens of multiple devices, prevents window content from being captured to enhance privacy, and keeps the iPad/iPhone screen always on when connected via USB. It is perfect for scenarios such as classroom presentations by teachers, collaborative business meetings, remote support, large-screen gaming experiences, enhanced mobile office productivity, or viewing videos and photos with multiple people. It instantly presents iOS content without the need for file transfers. Setup is simple – just connect via USB, trust the device, allow camera access, and Simply pair via Bluetooth to start using it. Enable Family Sharing so that the whole family can easily benefit.

item.title: Glow 3.6.0
item.description:
Elegant macOS menu bar icon hiding tool

Glow is a menu bar management and appearance customization tool for macOS 26 and macOS 27, supporting both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. It integrates icon organization, a liquid glass effect, and desktop style switching. It can arrange permanent, collapsed, floating, and hidden items based on frequency of use, bring up the desired icons by hovering, clicking, or using keyboard shortcuts, and open the item's actual menu in a floating panel. Floating items support grouping and independent shortcuts, while Glow Search allows you to search for menu bar items, appearance presets, and layouts by name. In terms of appearance, there are three styles available: single, dual, and segmented. You can adjust the transparency of the glass, the color tone, the borders, the shadows, and the rounded corners, allowing the colors to change with the wallpaper, and customize the Apple logo and the rounded corners of the screen. Moods can save the appearance of the menu bar and optional wallpapers, while also linking layouts, the Dock, Shortcuts, and Focus modes, making it easy to switch between different work scenarios. The software also offers quick appearance editing in the menu bar, independent style settings for multiple monitors, and haptic feedback for the trackpad, balancing daily operational efficiency with desktop personalization.

item.title: Snapback Pro 0.50.1
item.description:
Mac Window Layout Save Recovery Tool

Snapback is a workspace layout saving and restoration tool for Mac efficient users, which can record all current applications, window positions, and the display they belong to through shortcuts, and quickly restore the complete work environment when needed. Whether it is development, design, meetings, or daily office, users can create named workspaces for different scenarios, reopen the application and restore the order and precise location of windows after switching tasks, closing the notebook, restarting the system, or replacing the external display. The software supports up to six monitors, recognizes changes such as display connection, unplugging, rotation and replacement, and automatically adjusts window allocation to avoid concentrating windows on the main screen. Snapback also provides keyboard-first window snapping, supports one-half, one-third, one-fourth, and full-screen layouts, and can be quickly arranged by holding down the Command key and dragging windows. The software resides in the menu bar, supports custom shortcuts, and can be used in conjunction with window managers such as Rectangle and Magnet to reduce the time of repeated dragging and adjusting windows.

item.title: Mac Everything 1.6.3
item.description:
Ultra-fast full-disk file search

Mac Everything/Pro Everything is an efficient file search tool, similar to the Everything app on Windows, designed to quickly find the files you need. The app creates an index by quickly scanning files on the disk, rather than relying on Spotlight's index. As a result, it currently does not support searching by file content, but this feature will be added in the future. Mac Pro Everything's features include fast searches, accurate results, and ease of use. Its features include optimized full-disk search, support for searching hidden and system files, in-app search, search by name or extension, support for multiple matching modes, and search by file size and modification time range. Users can sort by file name, file size, and modification time, with support for case-sensitive searches and folder filtering, as well as file preview and batch processing functions. Mac Everything also supports regular expressions, making it easy for users to perform complex searches, as well as drag-and-drop functionality for easy interaction with other applications. It is a file management tool worth downloading.

item.title: Vitals 1.13.10
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: CleanShot X 5.0.4
item.description:
Professional screenshot annotation and screen recording tool for macOS

CleanShot X is a powerful screen capture tool designed to enhance the screenshot, screen recording, and annotation experience for Mac users. It is not only a powerful alternative to macOS's native tools, but also integrates over 50 features, such as quick access to sharing, scrolling capture, video recording, and text recognition, to meet the needs of various workflows. Users can easily annotate screenshots, upload them, and generate shareable links. It supports custom domain names and brand management, facilitating team collaboration. CleanShot X also features efficient audio and video recording capabilities, displaying mouse clicks and keyboard input to make screen recordings more interactive. The app also offers practical features such as delayed screenshots, custom wallpapers, and quick resizing, significantly boosting productivity. Users generally praise CleanShot X's annotation tools and workflow improvements, considering it an essential screenshot and recording app on the Mac platform. CleanShot now offers a 30-day risk-free money-back guarantee, allowing users to confidently experience this powerful tool.

item.title: BetterMacWidgets 2.19.0
item.description:
macOS High Face Desktop Widget

BetterMacWidgets is a desktop widget tool for macOS 15 and above running on Apple Silicon Mac that places weather, music playback, system status, to-dos, notes, clocks, world time, calendars, photos, cryptocurrencies, web traffic, Bluetooth devices, app launchers, shortcuts, timers, stopwatches, unit converters, and password generators directly on the desktop. The software provides 25 widgets and 20 themes, supports free drag and drop and invisible snap meshes, so that widgets of different sizes are neatly arranged; weather supports real-time forecasting and custom cities, music widgets can connect Spotify or Apple Music and playback control, and photo widgets can read specific folders and play dynamic slides. The liquid glass exterior supports transparent suspension and adjustable frosting, and the Pro version also offers the same size widget stacking, desktop layout configuration, cross-monitor adaptation, and automatic switching by time, front-end application, or connected display.

item.title: CoolDock 2.2.5-beta.4
item.description:
Mac Dock Enhancement Tool

CoolDock is an intelligent second Dock tool for macOS Sonoma and higher, which does not replace the original Dock of the system, but provides a separate docking bar next to it that can carry real-time components, shortcuts, application entrances, and daily information. Users can centralize music playback, weather, calendar events, reminders, to-dos, pomodoros, system status, searches, clipboards, screenshots, file shelves, download directories, quick switches, and more in one beautiful dynamic dock, reducing the frequency of switching between multiple apps. The software emphasizes local and privacy priorities, and only requests permissions such as calendars, reminders, photos, microphones, accessibility, or automation when required by the relevant features. It also supports app and folder fixing, multiple Dock configurations, floating layouts, resizing and appearance adjustments, wallpaper decoration, and modern Mac workflows with external displays, allowing users to build a more efficient and personalized desktop action center according to their own habits.

item.title: Iconscape 1.2.19
item.description:
Mac wallpapers that change with icons

Iconscape is a macOS dynamic wallpaper app that changes with the layout of desktop icons. It generates landscapes such as bays, meadows in the clouds, city blocks, or ski slopes based on the position and size of the screen and icons. After dragging a file, the terrain adjusts accordingly. Adjacent icons can share an island or a rooftop, and the icons and their names remain clearly visible at all times. After enabling "Follow Desktop Stacking," the landscape will also adapt to the stacking position and the files displayed when expanded. The wallpaper can switch between day and night based on the local sunset time or the macOS dark mode. After nightfall, window lights, lanterns, and campfires will illuminate. Once the landscape has been rendered, macOS drives the animations of scene elements such as swimmers, cable cars, and fireflies. These animations automatically pause when the desktop is obscured by windows or when Low Power Mode is enabled. Multiple monitors can each set their own scenes and be paused independently, and the app will also set a static snapshot for the lock screen. Iconscape resides in the menu bar and reads icon positions and sizes through Finder, with the relevant data stored locally. The app supports macOS 14 Sonoma and later versions and is compatible with both Apple silicon and Intel-based Macs.

item.title: Mote 1.6.1.1
item.description:
macOS Hover Markdown Editor

Mote is a native floating Markdown workbench for macOS that opens a lightweight window above all apps with shortcuts to quickly take ideas, edit notes, run terminal commands, organize web materials, and work on meeting content. It supports WYSIWYG Markdown rendering, with titles, bold, code, checkboxes, and math expressions rendered directly as you type, and offers Vim mode, plain Markdown pasting, and a variety of themes. Mote also integrates YouTube learning notes, microphone and system audio local transcription, speaker tags, Obsidian library reading and writing, web scribbling, clipboard collection, regular review, and AI agent collaboration such as Claude Code. Both notes and transcriptions can be saved locally on the Mac, and the file remains in a user-controlled Markdown format, independent of the cloud, account, or conference robot. Built with Swift and AppKit for macOS 15 and above, the software starts up quickly, takes up less resources, and is suitable for users who need to quickly switch between reading, conferencing, writing, and development.

item.title: Floodtide 1.6.4
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.

item.title: Downie 4 4.13.6
item.description:
Powerful web video downloader

Downie is a powerful video downloader that makes it easy to download videos from the internet and supports over 1000 websites including YouTube, Bilibili and Vimeo. Downie supports 4K video downloading with automatic post-processing to convert videos to MP4 format for iPhone or iPad, or to extract audio tracks only. Downie also provides history synchronization, fast support, and frequent updates to ensure users are always able to download the latest content. Downie also supports multilingual localization, and users are welcome to provide translations for a free license. Downie's user interface is simple and easy to use, and users can quickly download videos by simply pasting a link, which greatly improves download efficiency. Whether you're getting short videos or saving audio, Downie is for you. Post-processing: Automatically convert videos to MP4 format or extract only audio tracks for easy playback on your iPhone or iPad. Quick Support: For email inquiries from users, usually respond within 24 hours and add the website requesting support in the next update.

item.title: Tuna 0.114
item.description:
macOS Native Modernization Launcher

Tuna is a new modern launcher for macOS, redesigned based on the classic interactive concept of Quicksilver and built from the ground up using native Swift, with an emphasis on speed, keyboard drives, and a stereotyped operating experience. It is suitable for macOS 15 Sequoia or update system. It provides a variety of input and execution methods such as Fuzzy Mode, Combo Mode, Text Mode and Talk Mode. Users can quickly locate applications, files or actions through fuzzy search, and can also complete more complex workflows with combined instructions. Tuna supports extension mechanisms and plans to introduce third-party extension capabilities that will allow the launcher to be used not only to open applications, but also to gradually assume the role of an entry point for automation, text processing, command triggering, and day-to-day efficiency. The overall interface is modern macOS style, suitable for Mac users who want to use the keyboard to reduce mouse operation, improve system navigation efficiency, and find the spiritual successor of Quicksilver.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.62
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.
